title: Scene 5 · T6 — Beth steps back; Susan in the mirror: '…and this is all you did?' (SH08–SH10)
line: It won't erase a wrinkle, no. Nothing does, not even what Paula paid for. It just stops the wrinkle being the first thing anyone sees. No needles. No downtime. Thirty seconds. / …and this is all you did?
motionPlan: Beth steps back one step behind Susan's shoulder and talks to her reflection ; Susan leans an inch toward the mirror and looks at her cheek ; Susan turns her head a little toward Beth
note: Waits for the Scene 5 ingredient cards' Confirm, then one Seedance call.
